sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Common centaury is an annual or biennial herb, usually 2–50 cm tall and often first seen as a basal rosette. It bears small pink flowers with five lobes and a narrow capsule. It grows on open, nutrient-poor soils across Europe, North Africa and western Asia.

sections.title: Flowers and traditional uses
sections.text: The plate shows the rosette, star-shaped flowers and characteristic capsules. The plant is known for its bitterness and traditional medicinal uses; those uses do not establish safe consumption or support treatment advice. No common food use was established.
